product.name: Relaxed Fit Cargo Pants
product.description: Relaxed-fit cargo pants in thick cotton twill with a casual, but not oversized silhouette. Zip fly with button, diagonal side pockets, back pockets with flap, and bellows leg pockets with flap and concealed snap fasteners. Pleats at knees for added width.
